title: El Llavero de Saltillo, MAJESTIC
comment: llavero-saltillo (MAJESTIC): lectura del testamento de don Gregorio Montemayor en su despacho de Saltillo, y luego una bodega vieja en la calle Allende al anochecer. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cinco se distinguen a simple vista. Ropa de diario, sin uniformes.

chars.ITZAYANA_CORDERO: Mexican woman, the humble widowed daughter-in-law of a rich family, 32 years old, warm brown skin, long straight black hair in a low ponytail, kind tired dark eyes, no makeup, a simple navy-blue cardigan over a white blouse, black trousers, a thin gold chain, her hands empty.
chars.ZULEMA_MONTEMAYOR: Mexican woman, the rich spoiled daughter of a powerful businessman, 41 years old, fair skin, a blonde highlighted bob haircut, red lipstick, a mocking expression, a cream designer blazer over a black top, large pearl earrings, big sunglasses pushed up on her head, her hands empty.
chars.REINALDO_MONTEMAYOR: Mexican man, the arrogant eldest son of a powerful businessman, 46 years old, light skin, slicked-back black hair with grey temples, a trimmed black beard, a charcoal suit with an open-collar white shirt, a gold watch, his hands empty.
chars.OLEGARIO_ZERTUCHE: Mexican man, an old family notary, 66 years old, light-brown skin, bald on top with white hair on the sides, round wire glasses, a white mustache, a brown tweed jacket, a white shirt and a dark-red bow tie, his hands empty.
chars.MUJER_BODEGA: Mexican woman, an elegant mysterious lady, 63 years old, light-brown skin, silver hair in a neat chignon, dark serene eyes, an emerald-green shawl over a long black dress, small emerald earrings, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_DESPACHOSALTILLO: Wood-paneled private office of a late powerful businessman in Saltillo, Coahuila, in the afternoon: a large dark wooden desk with a green banker's lamp and a leather folder, two leather armchairs, bookshelves, a big window with the dry Saltillo mountains in the distance, a framed photo of a fleet of trucks without any readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
locs.LOC_BODEGAALLENDE: Inside an old brick warehouse in Saltillo at dusk: dusty wooden floor, old furniture covered with white sheets, stacked wooden crates, a single warm floor lamp lit in the middle next to an old velvet armchair, high small windows with the last orange light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
